thesis: Robert Hagstrom argues that investing should embrace a multidisciplinary approach using lessons from fields like physics, biology, and psychology to build a web of knowledge for better decisions. He states that investment decisions become more certain when ideas from these various disciplines lead to the same conclusions, providing additional confirmation that emboldens thinking and increases confidence to act.
